subject: QuasarPay vendor audit - tabletop output, redaction & witness scheduling
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@quasarpay.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QuasarPay SOC2/SIG - DR tabletop & RTO evidence ask

Hi Neha / Karthik,

QuasarPay is running a vendor refresh for SOC2 and SIG and our security team has flagged Redwood for a focused BCP/DR evidence package. Can you provide the following by Friday 2025-08-14?

- A condensed tabletop exercise report covering the May 2025 incident (1-2 pages)
- RTO and RPO attestation for the primary inference service (document signed by ops lead)
- Restore trace evidence for the May 12-13 restore (raw traces or redacted CSV)
- Ops runbook excerpt that shows failover steps and on-call contacts

We may also request a live witness session the week of Aug 18 to walk through the tabletop. Please let me know if redaction is required for logs or if a sanitized dataset is preferred.

Attachments: none yet (we're collecting vendor artifacts in our portal)

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Tran
Senior Manager, Vendor Security
QuasarPay

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@quasarpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-07T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuasarPay SOC2/SIG - DR tabletop & RTO evidence ask

Emily, thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Karthik (runs DR artifacts) and Monica (ops lead who can witness). Our plan:

Deliverables we will provide by Aug 13 (one day early):
1) Tabletop summary (PDF) describing scenario, participants, decisions, and action items
2) RTO/RPO attestation (docx) signed by Ops and Head of Reliability
3) Restore traces - we can provide a sanitized CSV and a full-trace file behind NDA if needed
4) Runbook excerpt for the failover path and on-call matrix

Two quick clarifying Qs:
- Do you need per-region RTO numbers or a single global RTO statement?
- For restore traces, do you want the full raw log set or a redacted/sanitized export?

We will attach an initial tabletop PDF and a proposed witness time when available.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@quasarpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuasarPay SOC2/SIG - DR tabletop & RTO evidence ask

Emily,

Thanks, we can do redacted traces. Attached to this thread are two files: redwood_tabletop_summary_QP-2025-08.pdf and restore_traces_may2025_redacted.csv. The redacted CSV replaces IPs and AWS account ids with hashed tokens; timestamps are preserved for timeline verification.

A short excerpt from the tabletop report is below:
- Scenario: multi-AZ network partition + control plane degradation on May 12
- Decision: failover to warm-standby in us-west and spin up cache-warming job to rebuild KV cache within 18 minutes
- Post-mortem: one downstream queue stalled, root cause fixed, and new pre-warm step added to runbook

On Fri Aug 7 you asked about raw traces; we can provide a full raw set under an NDA or via the vendor portal link you provided.

Attachments (attached to this message): redwood_tabletop_summary_QP-2025-08.pdf, restore_traces_may2025_redacted.csv

-Karthik
Principal Reliability Engineer

From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@quasarpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-09T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuasarPay SOC2/SIG - DR tabletop & RTO evidence ask

Karthik/Neha,

This looks good, thank you. Redacted CSV is fine for the initial review. We will request the full raw traces only if the auditor needs timeline-level validation; an NDA is fine.

Two asks before the witness session:
- Please provide an attestation document signed by Ops (pdf or DocuSign) stating the committed RTO/RPO numbers per region (if you have per-region numbers, include them).
- We will record the witness session. Please confirm ops is comfortable with a recorded walk-through and whether screen-sharing of runbook pages is permitted.

Portal link for upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QuasarPayVendorPortal
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4592

Proposed witness window: Aug 18-22, prefer Aug 19 11:00 PT.

Emily

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@quasarpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-11T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuasarPay SOC2/SIG - DR tabletop & RTO evidence ask

Emily, all good on our side. We will:

- Upload the signed RTO/RPO attestation (rto_rpo_attestation_2025.docx) and the full tabletop PDF by EOD Aug 13 to the portal.
- Confirm ops is OK with a recorded witness and screen-sharing; we are fine with both.
- Schedule the witness call for Aug 19 11:00 PT and will send a calendar invite with dial-in and a Zoom recording opt-in.

If you need the full raw traces sooner, say the word and we will initiate the NDA and transfer.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: rto_rpo_attestation_2025.docx (will be uploaded), restore_traces_may2025.csv (available upon NDA)
